scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students
text_representation:
Scheme: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students

Description:
A Maharashtra scheme administered through MahaDBT for eligible OBC students pursuing post-matric education, subject to domicile, income, attendance, course, gap, admission, and family-beneficiary conditions.

Benefits:
- Tuition fee, examination fee, and maintenance allowance support according to the applicable course group and official schedule.

Eligibility:
Age Range: None to None years
Gender: all
Max Income: None INR
Categories: 
State Domicile: Maharashtra

Documents:
Caste certificate, Income certificate or income declaration, Previous examination marksheet, Gap declaration when an education gap exists, Leaving certificate, Ration card, Parent or guardian declaration regarding beneficiary children

Application Process:
[{'step_number': 1, 'description': 'Register or sign in on the MahaDBT applicant portal.', 'channel': 'Online', 'verification_status': 'VerificationRequired', 'source_ids': ['src-maha-dbt-portal-005']}, {'step_number': 2, 'description': 'Complete the applicant profile, select Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students, upload the current required documents, and submit.', 'channel': 'Online', 'verification_status': 'VerificationRequired', 'source_ids': ['src-maha-obc-details-004', 'src-maha-dbt-portal-005']}]

Scheme: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

Description:
PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme that provides financial support of Rs 6,000 per annum to landholding farmer families across India, transferred directly into their bank accounts in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 every four months.

Benefits:
- Direct bank transfer of Rs 6,000 annually in 3 equal installments of Rs 2,000.

Eligibility:
Age Range: None to None years
Gender: all
Max Income: None INR
Categories: 
State Domicile: Central / All States

Documents:
Cultivable Land Record / Khatauni, Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account

Application Process:
[{'step_number': 1, 'description': 'Register online at PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit nearest Common Service Center (CSC).', 'channel': 'Online', 'verification_status': 'Verified'}]

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
text_representation:
Scheme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)

Description:
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health insurance scheme fully financed by the government. It provides a cover of Rs 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empanelled public and private hospitals in India.

Benefits:
- Cashless hospitalization coverage up to Rs 5,000,000 per family annually.

Eligibility:
Age Range: None to None years
Gender: all
Max Income: None INR
Categories: 
State Domicile: Central / All States

Documents:
Aadhaar Card or E-KYC Identity, Ration Card or Ayushman Card

Application Process:
[{'step_number': 1, 'description': 'Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit any empanelled hospital with Ayushman Mitra.', 'channel': 'Online', 'verification_status': 'Verified'}]

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
text_representation:
Scheme: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

Description:
PM SVANidhi is a micro-credit scheme providing street vendors with collateral-free working capital loans starting from Rs 10,000, with enhanced limits up to Rs 50,000 upon timely repayment, along with digital cashback incentives.

Benefits:
- Collateral-free working capital loan up to Rs 50,000 with 7% interest subsidy.

Eligibility:
Age Range: None to None years
Gender: all
Max Income: None INR
Categories: 
State Domicile: Central / All States

Documents:
Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body, Aadhaar Card

Application Process:
[{'step_number': 1, 'description': 'Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through nearest CSC or lending bank branch.', 'channel': 'Online', 'verification_status': 'Verified'}]

[{'step_number': 1, 'description': 'Visit any India Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch to open SSY account.', 'channel': 'Offline', 'verification_status': 'Verified'}]
